correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md and verify.py at Git tree 3ba88f9e2c8479d29d1ceb874c0249e7abd09df4 were inspected. In a connected threshold creation word with singleton zero blocks, a stalled nonempty white set of size 1 cannot occur; a stalled nonadjacent pair requires open twins, ruled out by strictly nested nonzero A_i neighborhoods, while an adjacent white pair forces. For size-3 stalled sets, the highest occupied clique B_j must contain at least two white vertices; a third must lie in B_j or before its block. Such triples are indeed stalled. Therefore min white stalled size=3, F^-=N-3 and M=Σ_j[C(b_j,2)*(j+Σ_{h<j}b_h)+C(b_j,3)]. An independently written exhaustive white-triple checker verified all 44 bounded positive b-profiles with p=2..4, 1<=b_i<=3, N<=10; this corroborates but does not prove the infinite result.

Determining all extremal triples and exact multiplicity addresses the counting question and yields an infinite family classification with potential direct combinatorial uses.
